Name: Fuilbhiast
Information:
**Fuilbhiast**

The gluttonous, blood-drinking fuilbhiast lives to devour the flesh and blood of mortal creatures, and is a rare sort of demon that does not care about the souls of those it consumes. It has an affinity with blood, which it can control in its targets to turn them against each other. The fuilbhiast absorbs blood through its very skin, soaking up death and lost blood merely by being close to the fallen.

***Muramasa’s Blades.*** The demon swordsmith Muramasa was a weaponsmith who conjured and bound a fuilbhiast, and drained its blood to quench the weapons he crafted. These fiendish weapons came to be known as Sengo’s Nightmares, and the smith eventually took their own life with one. These ravenous weapons would demand to drink the blood of their victims, and if there was none to drink, they would turn on their own wielders.

traits.name: Bloodstealing Aura
traits.description: At the start of each of the demon’s turns, it gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws for each newly dead Small or larger body within 30 feet of it (newly dead meaning died within the last minute) and each dying creature within that range. This bonus cannot exceed its proficiency bonus, and remains until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Dregdrinker
traits.description: When the demon scores a critical hit, it regains hit points equal to the damage its extra critical damage dice deal.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The demon makes three weapon attacks, each of which it can replace with its Sanguine Manipulation. It cannot target the same creature with Sanguine Manipulation more than once as part of this action.

actions.name: Bladed Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sanguine Manipulation
actions.description: The demon attempts to seize control of the blood of one creature within 30 feet of it, who must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage and must use their reaction to move up to half their movement speed to make a single weapon attack, or cast a cantrip they’re capable of that would deal damage. In either case, the demon chooses the target(s) of these actions, but the target creature makes their own rolls for attacks. On a success, they take half as much necrotic damage and aren’t forced to act.
